notes: Excerpt of the FY 2025 budget (Local Budget Preparation Form No. 2, Programmed Appropriation and Obligation by Object of Expenditure), 49 scanned pages: printed pages 150-183 of 408 (scans p-01 to p-34: Lapu-Lapu City College [tail], City Health Officer, City Social Welfare and Development Officer, City Veterinarian, CENRO, City Engineer, City Tourism), then pages 7-18 of 47 (p-35 to p-46: Lapu-Lapu City Hospital, Sta. Rosa Community Hospital, Non-Office LDRRMF for the hospitals), then pages 5-7 of 18 (p-47 to p-49: Market and Slaughterhouse). The last two runs are separately paginated budget documents (hospital and market/slaughterhouse economic enterprises) bound into this PDF.

No 'Calendar Year' line is printed; period.printed is the budget-year column heading. Columns: 2023 Past Year Actual, 2024 First Semester Actual, 2024 Second Semester Estimates, 2024 Total, 2025 Budget Year Proposed. Amounts in full pesos. Scanned page p-30 (page 179 of 408) is upside down.

Account codes are transcribed as printed; codes printed with a leading dash carry the fund/office prefix of the first code in the block. The printed sub-account suffix (e.g. '-1', '-24s1' = 2024 project 1) is kept after a space.

Lapu-Lapu City College (lapu-lapu-city-college): only the end of its MOOE list (3 items), the MOOE SUB-TOTAL, the Capital Outlay list and the GRAND TOTAL are on these pages (page 150-151 of 408); its Personal Services and the earlier MOOE items are in Part 2. The MOOE SUB-TOTAL and GRAND TOTAL therefore do not equal the items/subtotals transcribed here, and summary.offices has ps = null although the GRAND TOTAL 62,825,543.00 includes PS.

City Social Welfare and Development Officer: the office prints several blocks, each with its own TOTAL, followed by one office GRAND TOTAL: the CSWDO proper (TOTAL 197,616,484.00), Special Purpose Appropriation - Senior Citizens (194,450,000.00), Gender & Development Office (1,035,000.00), Operation of Homecare Center (3,300,000.00), Stimulation and Therapeutic Activity Center (510,000.00), Person w/ Disability Affairs Office (34,430,000.00) and Solo Parent Welfare Program (13,500,000.00). Each block is its own table; the GRAND TOTAL (444,841,484.00 proposed) is in table 'cswdo-grand-total' and equals the sum of the block totals in the budget-year column. The GAD Office and Homecare blocks print only a MOOE list and a TOTAL (no sub-total), so summary.offices takes their MOOE from the printed TOTAL.

Non-Office LDRRMF (non-office-ldrrmf, page 18 of 47): the 30% Quick Respond Fund is a separate printed block (section 'qrf', 1,200,000.00 proposed) reported in summary.offices as 'qrf', so PS+MOOE+CO (2,800,000.00) is less than the printed TOTAL 4,000,000.00 by exactly the QRF. The 70% Preparedness MOOE line has no 2025 proposed amount printed.
City Tourism: Personal Services has no 2023 actual or 2024 first-semester amounts printed (blank), only 2024 second-semester estimates.

Blurred/obscured cells read with the help of two independent printed checks: CSWDO Telephone Expenses-Mobile 2023 actual 181,800.00 is partly covered by the 'Received' stamp (the reading equals the MOOE sub-total residual); Lapu-Lapu City Hospital Hazard Pay - Casual 2024 second semester 3,869,198.84 (blurred 0/8; matches both its row total 6,098,232.00 and the PS sub-total); Sta. Rosa Repairs and Maintenance - Building 2024 second semester 129,838.00 (blurred 0/9; matches its row total 150,000.00 and the MOOE sub-total); Market and Slaughterhouse MOOE SUB-TOTAL 2024 second semester 7,787,442.46 and 2025 proposed 15,108,098.00 (blurred 5/8 and 6/8; both match the items and the printed Grand Total); Market Retirement and Life Insurance Premiums 2025 proposed 859,784.00.

Unreadable: Lapu-Lapu City Hospital 'Purchase of Stainless Food Conveyor, Close Type' 2025 proposed reads as 10,000.00 or 40,000.00 (first digit ambiguous); with it null the printed MOOE SUB-TOTAL 144,746,946.00 exceeds the other items by 40,000.00. Market and Slaughterhouse 'Monetization of Leave Credits' 2025 proposed reads as 267,745.00 or 287,745.00; with it null the printed PS SUB-TOTAL 12,391,902.00 exceeds the other items by 287,745.00. Both left null rather than guessed.
Every other row satisfies First Semester + Second Semester = Total, and every other sub-total and office total equals its items in all five columns.
